findings: Legacy HYPOTHESIS_VERSION records without scope fields recover the same candidate-bound axes into ranked_prior_entries and Critic capsules. Shared discovery_candidate_scope is not applied. A runner-up packet keeps that candidate's scope, drops a mismatched discovery result including a sparse executed scope, and still raises EXACT_PRIOR_SCOPE_MATCH on a same-scope HARD_CLOSE.

LegacyRankedPriorRecoveryTests starts from a payload without target or estimand and checks real preflight ranked_prior_entries against Critic capsules. PerCandidateScopePersistenceTests keeps selected A and runner-up B scopes distinct, drops A's result on mismatch and on a sparse executed scope, and raises on an exact runner-up close.

Shared discovery scope is not stamped onto every hypothesis. Runner-up scope comes from that candidate's card. A mismatched or sparse executed look does not keep the primary discovery result. A same-scope close still raises.

The readout matches the repair: recoverable scope reaches Prompt A and Critic, a mismatched runner-up drops the primary result and records its own prior relations, and technical stops do not ban a family. No new owner hand step.
